title: Detailed aeroplane
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Sky glow hint (subtle, not a background) -->
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='bodyGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#e8f0ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b0c4de'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='wingGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#f5f9ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#9ab8d8'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Fuselage main body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='58' rx='34' ry='9' fill='#d4e2f0'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='56' rx='34' ry='8' fill='#eef4fc'/>
  <!-- Fuselage belly shading -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='61' rx='30' ry='5' fill='#a8c4e0'/>

  <!-- Cockpit window -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='53' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#4fc3f7'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='52' rx='4.5' ry='2.5' fill='#80d8ff'/>
  <!-- Cockpit highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='51' rx='2' ry='1' fill='#e0f7ff'/>

  <!-- Nose tip -->
  <ellipse cx='82' cy='57' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#c8d8e8'/>
  <ellipse cx='83' cy='56' rx='1.5' ry='2.5' fill='#e8f2ff'/>

  <!-- Tail fin (vertical stabilizer) -->
  <polygon points='18,56 12,30 22,30 28,56' fill='#6aa0d0'/>
  <polygon points='18,56 14,33 22,33 26,56' fill='#9cc4e8'/>
  <!-- Tail fin stripe -->
  <polygon points='17,48 12.5,34 16,34 20,48' fill='#ff6b6b'/>

  <!-- Horizontal stabilizers -->
  <polygon points='22,55 8,48 14,52 24,57' fill='#8ab8e0'/>
  <polygon points='22,59 8,66 14,62 24,59' fill='#8ab8e0'/>
  <polygon points='23,56 12,51 15,54 24,57' fill='#b0d0f0'/>
  <polygon points='23,58 12,63 15,60 24,58' fill='#b0d0f0'/>

  <!-- Main wing (upper) -->
  <polygon points='42,56 30,32 48,34 56,56' fill='#7ab0e0'/>
  <polygon points='45,55 34,36 48,37 53,55' fill='#a8d4f8'/>
  <!-- Wing stripes -->
  <line x1='36' y1='40' x2='52' y2='42' stroke='#ff8a80' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='37' y1='44' x2='51' y2='46' stroke='#ff8a80' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Wing tip light -->
  <circle cx='31' cy='32' r='2' fill='#ff5252'/>
  <circle cx='31' cy='32' r='1' fill='#ffcdd2'/>

  <!-- Main wing (lower) -->
  <polygon points='42,60 30,84 48,82 56,60' fill='#7ab0e0'/>
  <polygon points='45,61 34,80 48,79 53,61' fill='#a8d4f8'/>
  <!-- Wing tip light -->
  <circle cx='31' cy='84' r='2' fill='#69f0ae'/>
  <circle cx='31' cy='84' r='1' fill='#b9f6ca'/>

  <!-- Engine (left) -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='65' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#5a90c0'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='64' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#8ab8e0'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='64' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ffcc80'/>
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='64' rx='1.5' ry='1' fill='#fff3e0'/>

  <!-- Engine (right) -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='51' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#5a90c0'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='52' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#8ab8e0'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='52' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ffcc80'/>
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='52' rx='1.5' ry='1' fill='#fff3e0'/>

  <!-- Windows along fuselage -->
  <circle cx='58' cy='54' r='1.8' fill='#4fc3f7'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='54' r='1.8' fill='#4fc3f7'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='1.8' fill='#4fc3f7'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='54' r='1.8' fill='#4fc3f7'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='54' r='1.8' fill='#4fc3f7'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='54' r='1.8' fill='#4fc3f7'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='54' r='1.8' fill='#4fc3f7'/>

  <!-- Fuselage stripe -->
  <line x1='26' y1='58' x2='80' y2='58' stroke='#4a90d0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>
  <line x1='28' y1='60' x2='78' y2='60' stroke='#7ab0e0' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.4'/>

  <!-- Landing gear hint -->
  <line x1='50' y1='65' x2='50' y2='70' stroke='#90b8d8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='71' r='1.5' fill='#e0e8f0'/>
  <line x1='62' y1='64' x2='62' y2='69' stroke='#90b8d8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='70' r='1.5' fill='#e0e8f0'/>

  <!-- Navigation light on nose -->
  <circle cx='84' cy='57' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- Small star sparkles for cute detail -->
  <path d='M88,45 l1,3 l3,1 l-3,1 l-1,3 l-1,-3 l-3,-1 l3,-1 z' fill='#ffe082' opacity='0.9'/>
  <path d='M14,22 l0.8,2.2 l2.2,0.8 l-2.2,0.8 l-0.8,2.2 l-0.8,-2.2 l-2.2,-0.8 l2.2,-0.8 z' fill='#ffe082' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
